title: •Captain Lennox
caption: •Captain Lennox (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}: any Star Destroyer. _Tyrant_ and •••Death Squadron Star Destroyers are deploy -3 and power +1 here, and their ability-1 permanent pilots are replaced by ability-2 permanent pilots.
lore: Captain of the Imperial Star Destroyer _Tyrant_. An able *leader*. Unlike most Imperial officers, he is dedicated to his ship and crew. Finds political maneuvering distasteful.

notes: Unique (•). Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2, third box blank. Slip deploy 2 / forfeit 5 (printed 3/5). Game text opens with the pilot-power icon then '3:' (no period) → {pilot:3}; 'Tyrant' italic; '•••Death Squadron' with three dots. Icons: pilot, warrior.
